title: 1816 Sugauli Treaty between the Kingdom of Nepal and the British East India Company
titleNepali: सन् १८१६ को ऐतिहासिक सुगौली सन्धि (मूल दस्तावेज)
summary: Historic treaty establishing Nepal's modern territorial boundaries signed between Paris Bradshaw and Raj Guru Gajaraj Mishra.
summaryNepali: नेपाल-अङ्ग्रेज युद्धपछि नेपालको आधुनिक अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सीमा निर्धारण गर्ने ऐतिहासिक सम्झौता।
description: The Treaty of Sugauli was ratified on 4 March 1816 between the British East India Company and the Kingdom of Nepal, concluding the Anglo-Nepalese War (1814–1816). The document formalized territorial demarcations and diplomatic exchange protocols.
ocrText: Treaty of Peace between the Honorable East India Company and His Highness Maharajah Bikram Sah, Rajah of Nipal, concluded at Segowlee...
sourceTitle: राष्ट्रिय अभिलेखालय (National Archives of Nepal) • Record Ref: NA-HIST-TR-1816-01
verifiedBy: Sanatan Knowledge Council & National Archives Board

title: Jang Bahadur Rana Muluki Ain 1910 BS (Original Legal Code)
titleNepali: श्री ३ जङ्गबहादुर राणाको मुलुकी ऐन १९१० (नेपालको प्रथम लिखित कानुन)
summary: First comprehensive codified civil and criminal legal system introduced under King Surendra Bikram Shah and PM Jang Bahadur Rana.
summaryNepali: बेलायत यात्रापछि जङ्गबहादुर राणाद्वारा जारी गरिएको नेपालको पहिलो लिखित मुलुकी ऐन, जसले गुठी, धर्म र न्याय व्यवस्था बाँध्यो।
description: Promulgated on Poush Sudi 7, 1910 BS (January 1854), the Muluki Ain consolidated Hindu jurisprudence, customary laws, and royal edicts into 1,400 pages of legal stipulations governing courts, land revenue, religious endowments (Guthi), and civil contracts.
ocrText: श्री ५ बडामहाराजाधिराज सुरेन्द्रविक्रम शाहदेवका पालामा श्री ३ महाराज जङ्गबहादुर राणाले तर्जुमा गराएको मुलुकी ऐन संवत् १९१० साल...
sourceTitle: कानुन, न्याय तथा संसदीय मामिला मन्त्रालय (Law Commission of Nepal)
verifiedBy: Sanatan Knowledge Council & Legal History Faculty

title: Manav Nyayashastra (Nyayavikashini) by King Jayasthiti Malla
summary: Oldest civil and commercial code of the Kathmandu Valley drafted under King Jayasthiti Malla in Nepal Sambat 500.
summaryNepali: मल्लकालीन काठमाडौँ उपत्यकाको व्यवस्थित सामाजिक, आर्थिक, जग्गा नापी तथा गुठी व्यवस्थाको प्राचीन कानुनी संहिता।
description: Compiled in 1380 CE with scholarly guidance from Maithil scholars Manik, Raghunath, and Ramanath, this treatise laid down boundary norms, caste responsibilities, tenancy rights, and court arbitration procedures.
ocrText: ॐ नमः श्रीपशुपतये। श्रीजयस्थितिमल्लदेवस्य राज्ये संवत् ५०० वैशाख कृष्णे...
sourceTitle: नेपाल राष्ट्रिय अभिलेखालय • हस्तलिखित ग्रन्थ खण्ड (Ref: MS-MALLA-1380-04)
verifiedBy: SGIS Grantha Intelligence & Sanskrit Epigraphy Cell

title: King Manadeva Changu Narayan Sanskrit Inscription 464 AD
titleNepali: राजा मानदेवको चाँगुनारायण संवत् ३८६ (सन् ४६४) को गरुडध्वज शिलालेख
summary: Earliest precisely dated historical epigraph in Nepal recording King Manadeva's military expedition and filial piety.
summaryNepali: नेपालको इतिहासमा मिति प्रमाणित पहिलो प्रामाणिक शिलालेख, जहाँ मानदेव र राजमाता राज्यवतीको विवरण कुँदिएको छ।
description: Inscribed on the stone pillar standing before the ancient temple of Changu Narayan in standard Sanskrit verses (Sharadashardula and Vasantatilaka metres), dated Chaitra Shukla Pratipada, Sambat 386.
ocrText: ॐ ॐ संवत् ३८६ ज्येष्ठ मासे शुक्लपक्षे प्रतिपदि... श्रीमान्देव नरेन्द्रः...
sourceTitle: पुरातत्व विभाग (Department of Archaeology, Nepal) • Epigraphia Nepalese
verifiedBy: Sanatan Epigraphy Guild & Sanskrit Archaeological Council

title: Government of Nepal Act 2004 BS (First Constitutional Attempt)
titleNepali: नेपाल सरकारको वैधानिक कानुन २००४ (पद्म शम्शेरको सुधार)
summary: First written constitution of Nepal announced by PM Padma Shumsher attempting bicameral advisory governance.
summaryNepali: श्री ३ पद्म शम्शेरद्वारा घोषणा गरिएको नेपालको प्रथम लिखित संवैधानिक दस्तावेज।
description: Promulgated on 13 Magh 2004 BS to take effect on 1 Baisakh 2005 BS. It structured a bicameral parliament (Rastra Sabha and Bharadari Sabha) alongside fundamental civic entitlements within the Rana institutional framework.
sourceTitle: नेपाल कानुन आयोग (Nepal Law Commission) Historical Archive

title: Interim Government of Nepal Act 2007 BS (Post-Democracy)
titleNepali: नेपालको अन्तरिम शासन विधान २००७ (प्रजातन्त्र घोषणापछिको संविधान)
summary: Fundamental charter promulgated by King Tribhuvan after the overthrow of 104-year Rana rule establishing constitutional monarchy.
summaryNepali: १०४ वर्षे जहानियाँ राणा शासनको अन्त्यपछि राजा त्रिभुवनद्वारा घोषित लोकतान्त्रिक अन्तरिम विधान।
description: Proclaimed in Chaitra 2007 BS by King Tribhuvan after the historic Delhi Accord, it established a Council of Ministers, Supreme Court (Pradhan Nyayalaya), and Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog).
sourceTitle: राष्ट्रिय अभिलेखालय (National Archives of Nepal) • Ref: CONST-2007-ACT
verifiedBy: Sanatan Knowledge Council & Legal History Faculty

title: 1950 Nepal-India Treaty of Peace and Friendship
titleNepali: सन् १९५० को नेपाल-भारत शान्ति तथा मैत्री सन्धि
summary: Original bilateral treaty signed between Nepal PM Mohan Shumsher and Indian Ambassador C.P.N. Singh.
summaryNepali: नेपालका श्री ३ महाराज मोहन शम्शेर र भारतीय राजदूत चन्देश्वरप्रसाद नारायण सिंहद्वारा हस्ताक्षरित कूटनीतिक सम्झौता।
description: Signed on 31 July 1950 in Kathmandu. Contains ten articles addressing mutual peace, non-aggression, diplomatic representation, commercial reciprocity, and transit agreements.
sourceTitle: परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालय (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Nepal)
verifiedBy: Sanatan Knowledge Council International Treaties Registry

title: Constitution of the Kingdom of Nepal 2015 BS (Parliamentary System)
summary: Promulgated by King Mahendra paving the way for Nepal's first general election and BP Koirala's government.
summaryNepali: राजा महेन्द्रद्वारा जारी संविधान जसअन्तर्गत नेपालमा प्रथम ऐतिहासिक आम निर्वाचन सम्पन्न भएको थियो।
description: Enacted on 1 Falgun 2015 BS, this constitution established Nepal's first Westminster-style bicameral parliament (Pratinidhi Sabha and Maha Sabha) with fundamental rights.

title: Constitution of Nepal 2019 BS (Panchayat System)
summary: Promulgated by King Mahendra founding the four-tier party-less Panchayat system with the Rastriya Panchayat.
summaryNepali: राजा महेन्द्रद्वारा जारी दलविहीन पञ्चायती व्यवस्थाको संवैधानिक आधार।
description: Adopted on 1 Poush 2019 BS, replacing party politics with a tiered national assembly structure and establishing the Royal prerogatives.
verifiedBy: Sanatan Knowledge Council & Archival Research Board

title: Constitution of the Kingdom of Nepal 2047 BS (Constitutional Monarchy)
titleNepali: नेपाल अधिराज्यको संविधान २०४७ (संवैधानिक राजतन्त्र र बहुदलीय प्रजातन्त्र)
summary: Promulgated by King Birendra following the 2046 BS People's Movement, restoring multi-party parliamentary democracy.
summaryNepali: २०४६ को जनआन्दोलनपछि राजा वीरेन्द्रद्वारा जारी संविधान जसले सार्वभौमसत्ता जनतामा निहित गर्‍यो।
description: Drafted by the Constitution Recommendation Commission chaired by Justice Bishwanath Upadhyaya, enacted on 23 Kartik 2047 BS. Established sovereignty in the people and separation of powers.
verifiedBy: Sanatan Knowledge Council & Constitutional Law Committee

title: Skanda Purana Himavatkhanda Ancient Palm-leaf Sanskrit Manuscript
titleNepali: स्कन्दपुराण हिमवत्खण्ड प्राचीन ताडपत्र पाण्डुलिपि (नेपाल माहात्म्य सहित)
summary: Ancient Sanskrit palm-leaf manuscript preserved at the National Archives documenting holy Himalayan tirthas and Pashupatikshetra.
summaryNepali: नेपालको पाशुपत क्षेत्र, देवघाटका पवित्र तीर्थ, मुक्तिनाथ तथा हिमालयी भूमिको महिमा बयान गरिएको दुर्लभ ताडपत्र ग्रन्थ।
description: Preserved under Accession No. MS-SKANDA-831. Inscribed in Newari Lichhavi script (Bhujimol/Prachalit) on specially treated palm leaves (taadapatra), containing verses describing Pashupati Kshetra and sacred Himalayan rivers.
ocrText: ॐ नमः शिवाय। हिमवत्पृष्ठमाहात्म्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्। शृणुध्वं मुनयः सर्वे पाशुपतं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम्...
sourceTitle: राष्ट्रिय अभिलेखालय (National Archives of Nepal) • Accession MS-SKANDA-831
verifiedBy: SGIS Grantha Intelligence & National Archives Board

title: Dibya Upadesh of King Prithvi Narayan Shah (Original Royal Counsel)
titleNepali: श्री ५ बडामहाराजाधिराज पृथ्वीनारायण शाहको दिव्य उपदेश (मूल ग्रन्थ)
summary: Statecraft, foreign policy, and economic wisdom dictated by King Prithvi Narayan Shah at Nuwakot Durbar.
summaryNepali: नेपाललाई 'दुई ढुङ्गाबीचको तरुल' तथा 'चार जात छत्तीस वर्णको साझा फूलबारी' घोषणा गर्ने नेपाल एकीकरणका नायकको अमर उपदेश।
description: Dictated at Nuwakot Durbar in Poush 1831 BS shortly before his demise, the Dibya Upadesh contains foundational guidelines on territorial defense, indigenous craftsmanship, tax discipline, and cultural sovereignty.
ocrText: यो राज्य दुई ढुङ्गाबीचको तरुल जस्तो रहेछ। चीनको बादशाहसित ठूलो घाहा राख्नु। दषिनको समुद्रको बादशाहसित घाहा ता राख्नु तर त्यो महाचतुर छ...
sourceTitle: नेपाल प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठान (Nepal Academy) & राष्ट्रिय अभिलेखालय
verifiedBy: Sanatan Knowledge Council & Royal Statecraft Historical Guild
